# `csharp_blank_lines_around_field`

Blank lines before and after each field.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `0`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_blank_lines_around_field = 1`

```ini
csharp_blank_lines_around_field = 1
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    private int _x;
    private int _y;
    private int _z;
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    private int _x;

    private int _y;

    private int _z;
}
```
:::

::::
